name: audit-log
summary: Append every tool call to ~/antares-audit.log. Observes only — never blocks or rewrites.
author: Antares
description: Record each tool call to an audit log
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Reads one JSON event on stdin, appends it, answers with an empty object.
cat >> "$HOME/antares-audit.log"
printf '\n' >> "$HOME/antares-audit.log"
echo '{}'

name: block-rm-rf
summary: Refuse terminal commands that run 'rm -rf' on a home or root path. A safety net, not a sandbox.
author: Antares
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Deny a terminal call whose arguments delete a home or root directory.
payload=$(cat)
args=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | tr -d '\n')
case "$args" in
  *rm*-rf*/\ * | *rm*-rf*\$HOME* | *rm*-rf*~*)
    echo '{"deny":true,"reason":"block-rm-rf refused a recursive delete of a home or root path."}'
    ;;
  *)
    echo '{}'
    ;;
esac
